newsitem.title: USA: Hungarian Tel to bid for Antenna Hungaria.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian Tel to bid for Antenna Hungaria.

text.p: Hungarian Telepone and Cable Corp said Wednesday it is preparing to bid in the privatization of a stake in Antenna Hungaria, the state-owned television, radio and telecommunications company.
Hungarian Telephone said the tenders are due in September and awarding is scheduled for December.
A company spokeswoman said the award would be for a 25 percent stake plus one vote.
Hungarian Telephone said the successful bidder would gain a "strategic management position" in Antenna Hungaria.
It said its plan is supported by Citizens Utilities Corp and TeleDanmark, two of its biggest stockholers.
Hungarian Telephone serves a market of 715,000 customers in Hungary.
